messages:
lina: Quick idea: name-spaces inside tenant quotas so teams can have soft budgets.

suresh: Enforcement? edge caches or central admit?

lina: Central admit authoritative, proxies cache namespace map with short TTL. Private deploys get sidecar.

maria: Soft isolation preferred (borrow_ratio) + per-namespace abuse detectors. Perf target: cached admit p99 <1ms.

quota-bot: [info] Add optional namespace_id to metering events (PLAT-1428).

lina: I'll open RFC with proto diffs and rollout plan (opt-in orgs, default namespace created).
